items.name: data-table
items.title: DataTable
items.description: Semantic table with a required caption, scoped column headers, optional sortable headers (button + aria-sort), zebra rows drawn with a hatch rule, and dense/comfortable density.
items.docs: Unofficial fan project, not affiliated with Square Enix or PlatinumGames. Compose DataTable (caption required), DataTableHeader, DataTableBody, DataTableRow, DataTableHeadCell (sortable, sortDirection, onSortChange) and DataTableCell (numeric). Density is set with density="dense" | "comfortable"; zebra is on by default (zebra={false} to turn off).
